title: Creating a Lens of Chinese Culture: A Multimodal Dataset for Chinese Pun Rebus Art Understanding

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating Vision-Language Models (VLMs) on a multimodal dataset of traditional Chinese pun rebus art using multiple-choice symbolic matching, element identification, and expert human evaluation of generated explanations. The evaluation identifies how models default to stereotypical or over-represented cultural symbols (e.g., bats, peaches, longevity, happiness) when uncertain, demonstrating a lack of nuanced cultural understanding.
